opening.argument: The video presents a structured promotional opportunity for Instagram users, centered on ordinary influencer campaign tasks rather than an investment request. Viewers are told to place a campaign link in their bio so visitors click it and generate payment: “You will get the money for that.” The interface then describes routine campaign requirements, including selecting a pricing plan, posting two stories, and using Instagram or Google email to access the service. A campaign screen shows ₹1500 alongside specified Instagram deliverables, while another shows ₹500 for every 100 visits and requires two Instagram stories. These materials frame the activity as promotional work with stated deliverables and payment terms, although the service, payment outcomes, and destination of the promoted link are not verified.
